body.statement: For every row-stochastic \(K\), universal validity for \(\pi\) holds if and only if \(d_K(A)\geq\pi(A)\) for every nonempty \(A\subseteq\Omega\). This is a strict tightening of partition sufficiency: it is necessary over the full row-kernel class and admits legal nonpartition kernels.
body.justification: The theorem converts validity for every unknown score into finitely many design-only inequalities.
body.gap: Zhang and Zhao (2023, Theorem 1) prove sufficiency for partition kernels; Ramdas et al. (2023, Theorem 2) use auxiliary randomization rather than characterize deterministic rows.
body.consumer: A network-randomization analyst can screen any outcome-free legal kernel before observing outcomes.
